answer_1.quote: Our approach extends the idea of multi-hop path extraction by combining multiple such paths into a graph -our Contextualized Commonsense Knowledge Graph.

answer_2.quote: We measure precision, recall and F1-scores for concepts and triplets. GED is normalized Graph-Edit-Distance; G-BS is Graph-BERT-Score

answer_4.quote: Two independent expert annotators manually labeled all 199 support instances in the ExplaGraphs dev set.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess recall by inquiring if the CCKG expresses implicit CSK completely, partially, or not at all, and precision by labeling individual triplets as positive, neutral, unrelated, or negative based on implicit CSK expression and topic relevance.
criteria: negative triplet rating (contradicts implicit CSK or conclusion)
